# The Palm Collection

> Three one-of-one automatic watches from Dubai. A hand-designed Palm silhouette at the heart of each dial, in three finishes (Black DLC, Stainless Steel, Gold PVD). Single price 5,500 AED (≈ $1,499) each. Free tracked worldwide shipping. Direct sale only — inquiries via WhatsApp, payment via Revolut. Private sale, not a retail establishment.

## The Collection

Three one-of-one pieces. Each with the Palm silhouette on the dial, an integrated bracelet and an exhibition case back. Shared movement specs: 24 jewels · 21,600 vph · ~41 h power reserve · automatic + hand-winding + hacking seconds.

- **The Palm · Black** — Automatic NH72A; black DLC case and integrated bracelet. Tagline: "Midnight over the Palm."
- **The Palm · Steel** — Automatic NH70A; brushed and polished stainless steel case and integrated bracelet. Tagline: "Daylight on the water."
- **The Palm · Gold** — Automatic NH71A; gold PVD case and integrated bracelet. Tagline: "Sunset over the fronds."

## Before you buy

- One of one: each watch exists only once. The piece you see is the piece you receive.
- Warranty: 12 months on the movement. If it stops keeping time, the maker will repair it.
- Sales: private sale, not a retail establishment.
